steps.content: [CG Continues]
Welcome to Otherworld, Chief!
Hey!! Out of the way!! Move, move, move!!!
Scattered fragments begin surfacing in your mind: the world tumbling through your vision, a windshield bursting into shards, and that streak of red hair sweeping past you at the very last moment.
Without a doubt, the person now standing before you is the one responsible.

options: So where am I? The afterlife?

steps.content: ...Uh... Y-yes! Yes, that! Haha... You got it!
I am the... the... the goddess <color=#e88490>Murphy</color>, who has guided you through your crossing!
The girl trips over her own words, utterly devoid of any goddess-like gravitas. You haven't been idle, though. Your shackles are already quietly engaged as you discreetly scan the area.
The shackles register a response. She's a Sinner. And whatever game she's playing, you need more intel before making a move...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So if you're a goddess, you shouldn't have any trouble answering a few questions, right?
She hesitates, just briefly, before her head dips and rises in a flurry of fervent nods.
The girl's gaze begins to dart around.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then I'll take your silence as a yes?
The moment she sees the shackles in your hand blazing with crimson light, the girl before you completely loses her nerve.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Wait! I... I don't know the answer to that!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What do you mean you don't know? You're a goddess. Shouldn't you, of all people, know this place?
Faced with a culprit who seems to talk around your question, you conclude that the shackles might just cut to the chase more effectively.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I-I'm sorry! I was actually coming to MBCC to turn myself in... but then the atmosphere back there was just so perfect, and I couldn't help myself... I just really wanted to say those lines!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Please, I'm begging you, go easy on me... Don't use those shackles...
She scrambles, yanking a wrinkled piece of paper from her pocket before, with a magician's flair, whipping out a steering wheel warped beyond recognition from behind her back.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: This is the evidence, and... this is my written confession.
As far as you can tell, there's good news and bad news.
The good news is that you came out of an all-out vehicular assault completely unscathed. The bad news... you honestly would have preferred waking up in a hospital bed.
Everything about this is beyond bizarre. You decide to go over the details one more time with the attempted-murder suspect standing right in front of you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you're telling me you came here to turn yourself in?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And that car was yours?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And then you deliberately ran me over and dragged me... wherever this is?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Yes. Wait, no, no, no! It wasn't on purpose! But this place... I honestly have no idea where we are. Here, look, you don't believe me, right? See?
The Sinner before you raises a hand and points beyond this hazy, liminal space. The moment she does, the blur sharpens into clarity, and the silhouette of a town resolves before your eyes.
You roll your shoulders, testing your body, then rise and make your way toward the Sinner waiting at the threshold.

You're just about to close the distance when, as though struck by a sudden thought, her face contorts with alarm. She springs backward in a panic, putting a solid two or three meters between you in an instant.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Chief, wait wait wait!!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If you get too close to me, all kinds of <color=#fb9259>bad luck</color> is gonna hit you.
The moment her words escape her lips, you catch it: the shadow pooled at her feet trembles, just barely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bad luck?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Like... small stuff, you know? Toothpaste falls on your foot when you brush your teeth in the morning. Flowerpot to the head the second you step outside. And if it's really bad... basically anything unlucky that can happen, will happen... Heh heh, yeah. That's just my life.
It's probably just a side effect of her Sinner ability. Powerful abilities often come with certain drawbacks; you've seen this sort of thing plenty of times among Sinners.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's fine. I've dealt with Mania way more ridiculous than this. Your bad luck shouldn't affect me, and besides, your ability might actually come in handy.
You brush the dust from your clothes. For someone who has weathered countless Sinner rampages and broken through multiple Black Rings, this degree of wariness feels more than a little unnecessary.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Really? But I've got a feeling—
[Whoosh of incoming magic projectile]
[Sound of explosion, tremor]

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Chief! Are you okay?! See?! I told you bad things happen when you're near me!
A purple arrow of magic thuds into the ground right at your feet. Murphy, beside you, springs upward like a startled kangaroo, barely hanging onto the steering wheel.
As the dust clears, you glance down at the still-smoking crater near your feet, then lift your gaze to the distance.

At the far end of the street, wave after wave of magical creatures pour into the district, wreathed in glowing magic. Though their forms differ from the typical Mania monsters, the incantations they chant and the spells they unleash are devastatingly potent.
The scene is utterly surreal, as though a horde of goblins and slimes from some medieval fantasy had wandered into the ruins of a fairy-tale kingdom.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stay calm. This space might be under Mania's influence, but combat should work the same. Use your Sinner ability.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Combat?! My biggest field accomplishment so far was running you over! I'm totally useless! Look, I say we split up and run. At least one of us might make it out that way!
On the verge of tears, she scrambles desperately to get away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about your ability? In a Mania environment like this, your power should be at its strongest.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I can't! If I use my ability, we'll probably make things worse!

No time to react. The swarming creatures surge forward. Above them, blue magic circles flare to life, and an instant later, a relentless barrage of ice shards and fireballs comes crashing down on your cover.
[Rapid Explosions]

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Ahhh! Hot hot hot—! My hair! I almost went bald just now!
Murphy scrambles across the ground in a frantic, graceless roll. In her flailing, the broken steering wheel gets kicked loose and goes sailing straight toward the oncoming horde.

What follows is a trajectory that defies every law of physics. The steering wheel bounces off goblin shields three times in quick succession, then, at an angle that makes no rational sense, slots itself perfectly into the tip of the lead creature's staff.
[Sound of explosion, tremor]
The shockwave from the blast sweeps through, toppling an entire row of creatures in an instant. Murphy, still sprawled on the ground, stares blankly at the destruction she's just unleashed.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Whoa... That actually worked?! Chief, did you see that?! Wasn't I amazing just now?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Didn't you just say we'd lose even harder?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: How about we just pretend that never happened...? Haha... ha... Anyway! If there's nothing else, I'll just be on my way—
Murphy pops upright and is already poised to bolt, but you seize her and haul her straight back.
